thread:
Mira: dropped a prototype for a compact rollout bar with a 'Quick stop' panic affordance and condensed version clusters. Frame: compact-quickstop-v1 (Figma link pasted).

Ben: Quick thought: 'Quick stop' might sound informal. What about 'Stop traffic' or 'Cut traffic'? Need to be super clear during incidents.

Lina: Vote for 'Stop traffic'  imperative verbs read better in CTAs. Also let's show a confirmation modal with a big red action and a smaller 'Cancel' to avoid misclicks.

Omar: UX nit: the compact bar currently pushes the timeline too far when history expands. Could we show clusters (1-3 recent versions) inline and then an expandable accordion for older history? That avoids full layout shifts.

Mira: accordion clusters were my plan. Inline cluster shows version tag, short commit line, and a tiny delta badge (+2 files). If user clicks 'Show more' it expands the drawer.

Aisha: accessibility flags: the red panic button needs role="button" + aria-describedby that points to a textual explanation. Also contrast: the small delta badges are only 2.8:1 on light bg. Need >=4.5:1.

accessibility-bot: Auto-check: contrast fail on token token-warning-100 for delta-badge (2.8:1). Suggest token-warning-700 on white or token-warning-100 on dark bg.

Ben: microcopy for modal: Title 'Stop traffic?'; Body 'This will immediately route 0% traffic to the active rollout and return to the previous stable version.' Primary: 'Confirm stop' (danger). Secondary: 'Cancel'. Thoughts?

Lina: 'Return to previous stable' might be confusing if there are multiple previous versions. Maybe 'Return to last stable release' or add small helper 'last stable = last successful deploy'.

Mira: ok I'll change body to: 'This will immediately return traffic to the last stable release.' and helper text: 'Last stable = most recent deployment that passed health checks.'

Omar: perf note: inline cluster diffing should be text-only and lazy render when expanded. No images or heavy markdown parsing on initial render. We'll bundle diffs in a separate API call.

Aisha: keyboard: ensure panic is reachable via single Tab from top nav. Modal trap focus and set focus to the destructive action so screen reader users hear the immediate consequence. Provide aria-live='assertive' updates after action completes.

Ben: also let's expose telemetry: how many seconds since rollout started and current % traffic in the compact bar. Operators want that visible without opening details.

Mira: added a tiny timestamp + percentage chip in the mock. It sits left of the CTAs.

Lina: small touch: when cluster expands inline, present a 'Back to timeline' quick link for keyboard users that restores focus to the cluster header.

Omar: I'll prototype a lazy-load signal: send a small 1KB placeholder for each cluster and fetch full diffs on expand. Estimate < 80ms extra network on typical infra.

accessibility-bot: Reminder: ensure focus styles meet 3:1 visual contrast and target size >= 44x44px for tap targets on mobile.

Mira: thanks! Action items: 1) I'll update Figma with 'Stop traffic' wording, modal copy, and cluster pattern; 2) Omar to share perf numbers in PR; 3) Aisha to propose two replacement color tokens that meet AA; 4) Ben to add telemetry fields to the API contract draft.

Ben: ping me when Figma is updated and I'll do a quick content pass.

Mira: will post updated frames here shortly. Appreciate the quick sync :raised_hands:
